calls.statement:
SELECT 
  CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS utc_date,
  COUNT(*) AS web_orders
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE)
ORDER BY utc_date
